entities.summary: Jakub Paul is a Swiss tennis player who specializes in doubles. He has a career high ATP doubles ranking of world No. 74 achieved on 10 November 2025 and a singles ranking of No. 288 achieved in 25 August 2025. Jakub Paul was a athletes & competitors from Chur (b. 1999-03-22, Chur). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
